Until the migration runs, /pricing?product=toefl-complete says the service was not found and the TOEFL group only lists what already has active plans.

Database: supabase db push --linked --include-all from an isolated copy that adds only 20261028110000_toefl_plans_and_complete_bundle.sql to the installed migrations, keeping the 9 pending #220 payment migrations (20261010162000-20261010174000) excluded. Dry run first. The inactive TOEFL Playbook 'test' plan (5f49a588-34e9-4503-8233-86076d82f457) is not touched.

Edge, after the migration (--project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel): supabase functions deploy access-effective; supabase functions deploy me; supabase functions deploy start-session; supabase functions deploy exam-state; supabase functions deploy review-session; supabase functions deploy trial-claim (these six bundle _shared/product-bundles.ts, which now expands TOEFL Complete for admin/sponsor grants and refuses its trial); supabase functions deploy learning-profile; supabase functions deploy score-prediction; supabase functions deploy recommendations (these three bundle _shared/sister-signals.ts, which now reads TOEFL playbook diagnostics and TOEFL simulator results in both the 2026 1-6 band shape and the legacy RLW shape; score-prediction keeps the two TOEFL scales in separate series).
